goal: Ask a model one question with a system instruction and a cap on output length, then return the answer text together with the input, output and total token counts.

Write a web-standard POST handler (Request in, Response out) for a chat UI. The client sends its message history in the body; stream the assistant's reply back in the format the SDK's React chat hook expects.

Give the model a weather lookup tool that takes a city name, let it call the tool and continue for up to five steps, and return the final answer plus the name and arguments of every tool call it made.
Get the model to return a recipe as a validated object with a name, a list of ingredients (each with name and amount) and a list of steps, and return that typed object.
Stream a completion to stdout piece by piece as it arrives, and when it finishes log the finish reason and total token usage.
Embed a list of strings in one call, embed a separate query string, and return the index of the list item most similar to the query.

Keep a running conversation in memory across multiple turns: export a function that takes the next user message, calls the model with the full history, appends everything the model produced to the history, and returns the reply text.
Stream a structured list of three product ideas (title and one-line pitch) so a caller can render partial results as they arrive, and resolve with the final validated list.
